name: American Studies (Min)

rules.name: Additional approved coursework to reach 28 units
rules.desc:
To earn a minor in American Studies, students must complete at least 28 units of coursework in the program. Because students may not count courses for both a major and a minor, the specific courses used for an American Studies minor depend on the courses used to satisfy the major requirement.
If the units for these requirements do not total 28, the student must take additional coursework appropriate to American Studies and approved by the Faculty Director, Associate Director, or Program Coordinator to meet the minimum unit requirement. Courses used to satisfy all units taken for the minor must be taken for a letter grade.

children.name: History, Politics, and Society
children.desc: Minors must complete two courses in history, politics, and society. Options include but are not limited to courses listed here.
children.notes: Note: For more course options, please refer to the American Studies website.

children.name: Literature, Culture and the Arts
children.desc: Minors must complete two courses in literature, culture, and the arts. Options include but are not limited to courses listed here.
children.notes: Note: For more course options, please refer to the American Studies website.

children.name: Race and Ethnicity
children.desc: Minors must complete at least one course that focuses on the study of race and/or ethnicity. (Note that this is in addition to courses taken under other requirement categories). Options include but are not limited to courses listed here.
children.notes: Note: For more course options, please refer to the American Studies website.

policies: Units from courses taken from other Departments/Programs within Stanford may count for major/minor requirements on the approval of the Faculty Director, Associate Director, or Program Coordinator.
transferPolicy: Units from courses taken at institutions that are not Stanford, which have been approved by the registrar, may count for major/minor requirements on the approval of the Faculty Director, Associate Director, or Program Coordinator.
reviewNotes: The audit checks the gateway seminar AMSTUD 160, two history, politics and society courses, two literature, culture and arts courses, one race and ethnicity course on top of those, and at least 28 units, every course taken for a letter grade. The lists are not complete, so another course the program accepts, from another department or another school, or extra coursework to reach 28 units, is moved in by hand with the Faculty Director's, Associate Director's or Program Coordinator's approval.
